release_read.basis: GAAP diluted EPS $1.92 against a $0.78-0.79 bar from one or two analysts (+143%), on a name whose print-day move has followed the EPS-surprise sign every time; tempered by revenue slightly under ($139.2M vs $140.7M), flat loans (+0.3%), customers -5.2%, new-customer originations -18%, and the CEO having pre-flagged a Q1-like quarter in September. Call at 10:00 ET still to come.

release.released_at_note: Exhibit 99.1 to the 8-K dated 2026-10-23, found 09:14 ET; acceptance time not read (no time to open the EDGAR index). The company's 2026-10-16 call notice says results are issued before the 10:00 ET call; prior prints were filed around 07:35 ET.
release.headline: World Acceptance Corporation Reports Fiscal 2027 Second Quarter Results

vs_bar.consensus_source: https://www.marketbeat.com/stocks/NASDAQ/WRLD/earnings/ (via the stage E-P hunt, fetched 2026-10-22); the brief's Nasdaq fallback forecast is $0.78 from 1 estimate

key_line.metric: EPS against the bar; provision and credit
key_line.detail: EPS $1.92 against $0.79, with no one-off adjustment in the quarter. Provision $46.0M against $49.8M a year ago. 61+ day delinquency 5.4% against 5.8%. Net charge-offs slightly worse at 17.6% against 17.1%. Gross loans +0.3% YoY, new-customer originations -18.1%, customer base -5.2%. 3.0% of shares bought back in the quarter (the Prescott block).

guidance.detail: No formal guidance, and none expected by the street (the company never gives any). Management says it has loosened new-customer underwriting and expects to 'carefully increase new customer lending in the coming quarters'.

call.detail: The call is at 10:00 ET today, half an hour into the session, per the company's 2026-10-16 notice cited in the stage E-P hunt; not yet held. A large GAAP beat leaves the call mostly on loan growth and new-customer volume into peak season, the release's weak spot. That is a two-sided risk for anyone holding past 10:00.

public_reaction.summary: No analyst action, wire story or retail chatter about today's print turned up by 09:18 ET. Search results still show date previews only. Coverage is 1-2 analysts, so an action may never come.

tape_read.note: The tape shows no pre-market print at all (prints 0, reference null, stale_at_open true). prev_close 169.66; entry 171.84, so the long starts 1.3% under water against the close. Market is soft: IWM -0.61%, SPY -0.44%. The opening print does all the price discovery for a +143% EPS beat. 'Undershoot' here means unpriced, not mispriced: a stale pre-market says nothing about direction after the open.

thesis_check.note: The thesis was a big EPS beat, based on the CEO's 'similar to Q1' remark against a stale $0.79 bar. GAAP $1.92 confirms it. The soft loan growth the panel netted in also shows up: loans +0.3%, originations -18%.

expected.open_lag_note: There is no pre-market move to hold, so the chance the open holds less than half of it is a coin flip by construction. With the stale tape the open is the first real price. The fade by 10:00 is also even: a gap on a 15%-short, thin float can squeeze in the first minutes, while earnings gaps usually give back part and the 10:00 call can cut either way.

recommendation.limit_basis: prev_close 169.66 x 1.128: the baseline's 12.8% median historical reaction (no option chain). The last two beats closed +13.0% and +16.3%, so a short squeeze on this thin, 15%-short float can plausibly reach that level at or after the open. Above it the gap runs well past what the release supports (+7%), and a fade is the likely path. Unfilled, the position goes at the close, in line with the bmo tendency to keep repricing through the session.
recommendation.reason: De winst per aandeel ($1,92) is ruim twee keer zo hoog als verwacht ($0,79). Dat bevestigt de koopreden van gisteren, maar de leningengroei is zwak. Voor de opening is er nog niet gehandeld, dus de opening bepaalt pas de prijs. Zet een verkooplimiet op $191,38 (+12,8% boven het slot van gisteren) om een eventuele piek door dekkende shortposities mee te nemen. Wordt die niet geraakt, dan gaat de positie bij het slot weg, omdat een ochtendcijfer meestal de hele dag doorwerkt.
recommendation.what_would_change_it: Als de eerste voorbeurskoersen voor 09:30 onder het slot van gisteren ($169,66) staan, of als er nieuws komt dat de winst door een eenmalige post is opgeblazen, verkoop dan bij de opening.
